title: The Regiment of Valparaíso
author: W. M. Sterling
blurb: Theo Underhill, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
